More ways we help

Practical solutions for real operational challenges.

Beyond custom extensions and integrations, we help teams improve reliability, simplify operations and prepare their technology for growth.

Order lifecycle & status

Connect order events across POS, kitchen, kiosk and guest-facing channels, including preparation updates and notifications.

Loyalty & guest identity

Bring guest identification, rewards and customer context into supported POS workflows through approved APIs and extensions.

Menu & pricing governance

Configure reusable menu structures, modifiers, pricing and channel-specific rules while protecting existing workflows.

Payments & reconciliation

Investigate payment-flow issues and connect transaction data with supported systems for clearer reconciliation.

Monitoring & incident support

Improve error visibility, logs, alerting and root-cause analysis to help teams resolve issues faster.

Rollouts & environment readiness

Support test planning, end-to-end validation, release coordination, documentation and multi-location rollouts.

Examples of the problems we solve

From capability gaps to smoother guest experiences.

Illustrative scenarios showing how restaurant technology projects can create practical business outcomes.

“

Custom loyalty capabilities at the POS

Our POS did not include the loyalty workflow we needed. A custom extension connected supported guest-identification and loyalty services, helping team members see guest context at the point of service.

Loyalty & guest experience
“

Future-ready menus without channel disruption

We needed a more flexible menu configuration without unintentionally affecting other ordering channels. The solution focused on reusable menu structures, controlled changes and careful validation.

Menu configuration & data consistency
“

Order status notifications for guests

Guests had limited visibility into in-restaurant order progress. Connecting POS order events to a guest-facing notification flow made preparation status easier to communicate.

Order tracking & notifications
“

Reliable integrations across the restaurant stack

When multiple systems were involved, the priority was to map data ownership, handle errors and retries, and test end-to-end scenarios so teams could operate with greater confidence.

Integration reliability
“

Faster troubleshooting and clearer ownership

Instead of passing an issue between teams, a structured investigation can trace the flow across POS, APIs and partner systems, document the root cause and define a practical fix.

Support & root-cause analysis
“

Built to scale across locations

Configurable integration patterns, rollout checklists and environment-specific testing help reduce repeated work when adding locations, partners or new digital channels.

Scalability & rollout readiness
